def QleisliKernel.Semantics.Ownership.OwnershipSafe : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Observation.Program → Prop :=
fun program =>
  ∃ initial final,
    And (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Ownership.Inputs { } program.inputs initial)
      (And (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Ownership.Run initial program.operations final)
        (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Ownership.Returned final program.outputs))
def QleisliKernel.Semantics.ClassicalScope.ScopeSafe : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Observation.Program → Prop :=
fun program =>
  ∃ initial final,
    And (QleisliKernel.Semantics.ClassicalScope.Inserts { } program.classicalInputs initial)
      (And (QleisliKernel.Semantics.ClassicalScope.Run initial program.operations final)
        (∀ (value : Nat),
          @Membership.mem.{0, 0} Nat (List.{0} Nat) (@List.instMembership.{0} Nat) program.classicalOutputs value →
            QleisliKernel.Semantics.ClassicalScope.Visible final value))
